title: 干了28年深夜秀：柯南亲口说，我在被请走前离开？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So you started your podcast in 2018. Yes. It's a top podcast in the US.
segments.zh: 你2018年开了播客。对。现在是美国顶级播客。

segments.en: This is how you spend a lot of your time now. Yeah.
segments.zh: 现在你很多时间都花在这上面。是的。

segments.en: Did you anticipate this when you started the podcast? How is it differed from what you expected when you entered podcasting?
segments.zh: 你开播客时预料到了吗？和你当初预想的有何不同？

segments.en: None of us was anticipated. I wrapped up, well, I knew I wanted to wrap up my late night gig soon.
segments.zh: 我们都没预料到。我结束了，其实我早就想结束深夜秀了。

segments.en: I had done about 28 years of between NBC, Turner, and I decided some people were kind of thinking,
segments.zh: 我在NBC和特纳一共干了大约28年，我决定，有些人觉得，

segments.en: well, if you can go to an even 30, and I thought, I think it's, I just, I've loved it, but you can kind of see which way things were going.
segments.zh: 如果你能凑满30年，我想，我觉得，我只是，我很喜欢，但你能看出趋势走向。

segments.en: And so in true sort of Irish tradition, I wanted to leave the party before I was asked to leave.
segments.zh: 所以按照爱尔兰传统，我想在被请走之前先离开派对。

segments.en: So I said, I know you want me to stay, but I better go.
segments.zh: 所以我说，我知道你想让我留下，但我最好还是走。

segments.en: Um, they, what was interesting was, so it's about a year and a half before I leave the show.
segments.zh: 嗯，有趣的是，那是在我离开节目大约一年半前。

segments.en: And someone who worked with us, Adam Sachs, is a very bright guy, just sort of suggested you should do a podcast.
segments.zh: 曾与我们合作的亚当·萨克斯，是个非常聪明的人，他建议你做个播客。

segments.en: And my initial response was, why would I do that?
segments.zh: 我最初的反应是，我为什么要做那个？

segments.en: You know, I have the TV show. I've been doing that for a long time.
segments.zh: 你知道，我有电视节目，已经做了很久了。

segments.en: And he said, you might have fun. So we said, let's do a test.
segments.zh: 他说，你可能会觉得有趣。于是我们说，那就试试吧。
